prose: Anthropic launches OSS Scanner, a free opt-in security audit for open-source projects. It sends AI-generated vulnerability reports without human review, which means maintainers may receive findings that are wrong.
The tool belongs to Anthropic's wider critical-infrastructure security push announced the same day. Details of how projects join were not in the excerpt.
highlights: Free opt-in vulnerability scans of open-source projects
Reports are AI-generated and not human-reviewed
Part of a wider Anthropic security push
